display.purpose: Two-line hero headline; responsive overrides are documented in Layout.

headline.purpose: Major section headings; local column-specific sizes remain in CSS.

body.purpose: Base reading rhythm; content contexts select smaller or larger sizes.

label.purpose: Actual metadata and compact controls; not an above-heading decorative label.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Button color/lift, navigation color, and toast opacity/translation.

motion.name: cover-transition
motion.purpose: Project identity scales to 1.045 on cover hover.

motion.name: demo-reveal
motion.purpose: One-time clip reveal of the theme demonstration.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: At prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, disable animation and transitions; use immediate anchor scrolling.

breakpoints.name: compact-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; reduce gutters and gaps.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; stack hero and contact; retain two project columns.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; single-column content and button-controlled navigation.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum width; increase hero vertical padding.

components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 22px; padding: 14px 21px; min-height: 50px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #d4f878); color: var(--background, #101622); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #e3ffa2; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .55; } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d4f878); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Illustrative Project Cover
components.description: Typographic identity with an explicit illustrative label.
components.css: .ds-cover { font-family: "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 292px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; text-align: left; padding: 23px 25px 18px; overflow: hidden; background: #c7dcd4; color: #30483d; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cover-meta { font-size: 11px; opacity: .85; } .ds-cover-brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; font-size: 59px; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-weight: 650; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-cover:hover .ds-cover-brand { transform: scale(1.045); } .ds-cover-rule { margin-top: 16px; width: 45px; height: 2px; background: #496456; } .ds-cover-footer { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; opacity: .85; } .ds-cover-arrow { width: 35px; height: 35px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-cover-arrow svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d4f878); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cover-brand { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
This name describes the implementation direction: precise developer details paired with the spacious typography and composed color fields of a brand lookbook. It is descriptive language for the shipped system. The durable user commitments are dark navy, lime, and a modern developer style.

The system is calm, confident, and content-led. Large headings anchor generous sections; supporting copy and fine rules create a quieter layer. Controls are compact and explicit. The palette stays consistent around the content while illustrative project covers can carry their own brand treatments.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy layers with lime actions and emphasis.
Manrope typography with tight display tracking and relaxed body leading.
Flat surfaces, fine borders, and gently rounded controls.
Spacious desktop columns that become readable mobile stacks.
Restrained interaction motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Lime Signal Rule
rules.body: Use lime for actions, selected states, and deliberate text emphasis, following the existing interface's hierarchy.

rules.name: The Heading First Rule
rules.body: Major sections begin directly with their heading. Put useful explanation below the heading and keep metadata attached to the item it describes.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Convey resting depth with color, borders, and overlap, as the shipped components do.

dos: Do preserve the dark navy foundation and lime action hierarchy.
Do start major sections with their heading and place useful explanation below it.
Do retain generous leading for reading copy and the implemented mobile stacking behavior.
Do show keyboard focus and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do label illustrative covers and storefront content honestly.
donts: Don't turn project-cover colors or typefaces into competing global brand accents.
Don't add shadows to the existing flat surface vocabulary without an intentional system change.
Don't replace actual project metadata with decorative section labels.
Don't present illustrative artwork as a supplied screenshot or a live client storefront.
